title: A Sleigh of One's Own
overview: One woman's journey of self-discovery and coming to terms with her husband's sexuality. That woman? Mrs. Claus.

title: Heart Eyes 2
overview: The sequel to the 2025 film. Plot TBA.

title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: Applause
overview: Two teenagers encounter a rock that gives them the power to switch places with the clap of their hands. However, one of the boys struggles with bullying, relationship issues, and sexual identity as he tries to navigate the world as a young adolescent.

title: A Place in Hell
overview: A top criminal defense attorney, known for representing unlikeable clients in high-profile cases, is a relentless workhorse at her firm and fully expects to be named partner. When another attorney joins the firm, her job is put to the test and makes her question just how far she’ll go to protect it.

title: The Surgeon
overview: A former surgeon is kidnapped and given an impossible choice.

title: The Nightingale
overview: The lives of two French sisters are torn apart by the onset of World War II.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: Relentless
overview: The story of a former soldier and an underground fighter who is diagnosed with cancer and is left with the decision to keep fighting to provide for his family in the long run. The joint battle with cancer versus the battle in the arena.

title: The Caged
overview: A family is terrorised by a dark presence after they move into a quaint cottage, and discover it lies on the site of a medieval prison which once housed women accused of witchcraft.

title: The Stolen Tape
overview: A noir action comedy about a detective trying to retrieve a missing videotape.

title: Sunnyside
overview: Spanning decades, cultures, and quiet family secrets, Sunnyside is an intimate documentary portrait of Nicholas, a second-generation Greek-American reflecting on a lifetime of memory, identity, and profound transformation. From a cramped childhood bedroom in Sunnyside, Queens, to summers at a Long Island bungalow, the film explores the contrast between a rigid city upbringing and the fleeting freedom of youth. As Nicholas tells stories of his own path—architectural journeys in Paris, coming to terms with his identity in 1970s New York, and finding true partnership—he uncovers unspoken truths about his family's immigrant sacrifices and long-buried grief. Now the sole survivor of his family of seven, Nicholas preserves their fragile legacy, offering a deeply poignant meditation on what it means to hold the key to a forgotten past.

title: Captain Bonanza!
overview: Daring hero Captain Bonanza -- né Hudson Hill -- uncovers a sinister plot surrounding three magic idols in the mystic Hudson Valley. But this scheme is far greater, and far deadlier, than he ever could have imagined.

title: Classified
overview: "I can’t put words to you, I can’t put labels to you; but what I can put are a whole ton of emotions and feelings to you, and even then I can’t put words to those."

title: Breaking the ICE
overview: A student-produced documentary created by Radio and Television students and faculty at Suffolk County Community College. The film explores the local impacts of ICE enforcement, deportation, and immigration on Long Island communities.

title: In N' Out
overview: Two agents are given a daring mission by their boss that entails boobytraps, antics and glizzys. Will they survive?

title: You Are There
overview: Eve is drowning in the grief of her friend, unable to accept her death; she tries anything she can to forget; however, her face is on every stranger on the street. Desperate to see her just one last time, she does anything she can to bring her back.

title: Hello, Parasites!
overview: Desperate to rejuvenate himself, Paul seeks a service from a strange man known only as the Provider, who promises a transformational experience.

title: The Man with the Bag
overview: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

title: The Elephant's Present
overview: James comes home for the holidays with the intention of repairing the strained relationship with his daughter.

title: best friends
overview: Being late for their party, two teenage girls must take a hike through the city to reach their destination.

title: The Defectors
overview: In a near-future surveillance state, a detective secretly aligned with a rebellion investigates the assassination of their leader under the watchful eye of his manipulative new partner.

title: Whispers of the Deceased
overview: After their father figure Paddy is murdered outside their nightclub, lifelong friends and crime partners Jack “The Bull” and Red O’Sullivan embark on a dangerous search for his killer. Their investigation exposes a devastating betrayal by their trusted ally Vito “The Architect” Valentino, forcing the pair to risk everything for revenge and control of their criminal empire.

title: The Wicked Hour
overview: A documentary director gathers her friends to document a haunted house, only to witness horrific paranormal activity.

title: I HAD A... (DREAM)
overview: I HAD A... (DREAM) unfolds as a trip where dance, stop-motion animation, sound, and imagery interplay, far from established dimensions and expectations. Mushrooms immerse the viewer in a dreamlike space, where the film becomes a site for deviation and disruption.

title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
overview: Azrael has guided countless souls into the afterlife, but has never understood why people choose to love, even though it always ends in loss. When he falls for a convenience store worker, one tragic night forces him to discover the answer for himself.

title: One Sweet Hour
overview: An ageing Elvis impersonator finally faces up to his demons as he travels through the Irish midlands with his long-lost brother, who has recently quit his life in a monastery.

title: Light Falling Down
overview: Set near the Treblinka death camp in Nazi-occupied Poland, a reclusive farmwoman risks everything to shelter a young Jewish girl in hiding.

title: Laterz
overview: An aspiring Melbourne rapper and her two best friends want to get her track on the radio and secure the clout that comes with the airtime. Over one afternoon in the suburbs, their dreams start to collide with reality.

title: Super Champions
overview: Seven people think about their place in the universe.

title: The Death of Marion Wayne
overview: Marion Wayne is a chaotic gunslinger traveling the country with his small gang. When he gets captured by the law he learns of an indifference of power within the law, and upon breaking out of prison he pursues a revenge arc to balance the system.

title: The Brownsburg Conversations
overview: A portrait of a Virginia community observed through its residents, who reflect on histories of race and slavery, the role of faith in shaping connection, and the possibility of regeneration, as tradition and modern life collide in an increasingly polarized America.

title: Snoopy Presents: 12 Days of Snoopy
overview: Eager to get off Santa's naughty list, Snoopy goes all out to be the nicest beagle in town.

title: Henry's Ebb
overview: Henry runs away from an abusive home with his imaginary best friend, Ebb. The journey tests their friendship, as well as Henry’s inner 'need' for Ebb as Ebb’s control and manipulation over Henry intensifies.

title: Royal Opera House: Carmen
overview: Carmen declares that any man she loves should beware. However, even she is unprepared for what will happen when she decides to seduce Don José, an army corporal who initially appears uninterested in her charms. Don José soon abandons his sweetheart Micaëla and his army job for Carmen, and joins her and her smuggler friends in the mountains. But Carmen quickly wearies of Don José's possessiveness. When she turns her attentions to the dashing toreador Escamillo, Don José's jealousy erupts into violence.

title: Chimeras Tonight (Too Mercury)
overview: In this dreamlike animation, two women fall in love and are metamorphosed into strange creatures, symbiotic with the natural world around them.

title: Being Heumann
overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

title: Lizzie
overview: A young woman, Eliza, returns to her hometown for summer break, and must confront a fragment of her past.

title: The Mosquito Bowl
overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

title: The Quest for Emerald Mountain
overview: Set against the arid mountains and wide skies of West Texas, two best friends chase the perfect photo for a model train and in doing so, create an unexpected portrait of intimacy, creativity, and tenderness in male friendship.

title: Hide
overview: A reclusive hunter clashes with her ambitious son over whether or not to capitalize on a tragic, coveted  family heirloom.

title: A Talent for Murder
overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

title: Kavor
overview: Leon's role as Kavor (an Armenian Godfather) unravels when his cousin Vaz arrives, sparking a feud that threatens the entire wedding.

title: Simon Says So
overview: An aspiring ventriloquist begins to crack under the pressure of his first performance.

title: Caught Between Lands
overview: An experimental documentary featuring international college students commenting on their experiences of cultural isolation in America.

title: GunBlade & Me
overview: An obsessed, washed-up Sydney filmmaker sets out to uncover what led to the cancellation of his viral high school web series, GunBlade Adventures.

title: Passing The Bar
overview: A job interview at a cocktail bar goes wildly off-menu when the interviewer decides to down every drink made for him.

title: Sterile
overview: Through crucifixions, fisting and forest rituals, a group of queer and trans friends create a folk-horror love letter to radical intimacies. Produced over 6 years, Sterile offers a utopian/dystopian vision blending original footage with once banned silent movie Häxan (1922), practical special effects, explicit performance and commentary to present a joyous, affirmative documentary about lost times in nature in a trans- and queerphobic world.

title: Eroded
overview: As rising waters wash away Toronto's historic queer beach, its community turns to archives, art, and memory to keep its legacy alive.

title: Human Remains
overview: Grosseto, early 1990s. In an abandoned quarry, Sami, a young Albanian boy, lives in isolation with Massimo, who looks after him. During the night, the arrival of a man with a kidnapped child transforms the quarry into a suspended, indecipherable space, in which Sami is left alone.

title: Epitaph
overview: In Epitaph, filmmaker Cecilia Araneda returns to her long-estranged homeland, eco-processing 16 mm film with leaves and fruit gathered from her ancestral home, weaving a lament for her family’s past and the vanishing landscapes of home.  Filmed in both Chile and on the Tablelands in Canada, a site central to the modern understanding of plate tectonics, Epitaph incorporates eco-processed 16 mm footage, video, documents from public and private archives, and found footage to weave an epitaph to a home in the process of leaving the filmmaker, first as a result of exile and then to the gradual movement of time.  Epitaph has been eco-processed on-site in rural Chile at the site of the filmmaker’s father’s family using boldo, figs, fig leaves, walnut leaves, apples, apple leaves, fall grapes, fall grape leaves, olives, olive leaves, plums, mint, yard flowers and other vegetation.

title: Chimp Outbreak
overview: An aggressive chimp has escaped confinement and creates a path of death and destruction.

title: Ann Arbor After Asphyxia
overview: The summer my dad died, I rediscovered the last birthday card he ever wrote for me.

title: Globe
overview: Globe is a cinematic folktale about identity, belonging, and resistance, set amid the tribal land struggles of Kerala. Seen through Kariyan, a young tribal boy, the film reflects the deep bond indigenous communities share with their land and the alienation they face in urban society. Rooted in Attappadi, the story subtly reveals ancestral dispossession and cultural erasure, urging reflection on justice, dignity, and the right to remain in one’s birthplace.

title: The Vampires of New Orleans
overview: The horrors of New Orleans history reverberate down to the present in this docudrama combining Southern Gothic terror with investigations into the city's real-life folklore.

title: Unsavory Elements
overview: Boys' night out to an Asian brothel becomes a bloody fight for survival.

title: Invention 13
overview: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: Shadows of Beirut
overview: A young woman decides to return to Beirut to see her estranged dying father after 25 years. Between the struggle to forgive him and building up the courage to face him, she discovers the heart of her homeland through the people she meets.

title: Rahul & Rosa
overview: Strange things happen to Rahul and Rosa as their relationship falls apart.

title: + Add Friend
overview: A working man must confront his secret shame as his online activity unravels into his personal life- following an intimate encounter with an anonymous internet user.

title: No Limbs No Limits
overview: The powerful true story of world-renowned speaker Nick Vujicic—a man who has defined what it means to live without limits. This film is more than a documentary; it’s a testament to resilience, faith, and the unstoppable human spirit. Born without arms or legs, Nick overcame his disability to live not just independently but a rich, fulfilling life, becoming a model for anyone seeking true happiness.

title: MAN or MOUNTAIN
overview: Defying evacuation orders and denying scientific evidence, notorious lodge owner Harry R. Truman is sent cascading through memories of a life lived without regret beneath Mt. St. Helens, as mounting tremors rock his cherished world.  Still basking in the limelight of his rebellion, imminent cataclysm forces him to finally face the truth of his grave decision: to be destroyed by what he loved.

title: Chow Time
overview: In pursuit of the perfect meal, Brighton goes to battle with his six roommates over control of the kitchen.

title: The Swallow
overview: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: Duck Duck Goose
overview: While working as children’s entertainers to supplement their slow-moving acting careers, best friends Jack and Bill decide to rob a house during a 9-year-old’s birthday party. As they attempt to carry out the plan without drawing attention, tensions rise and their friendship is put under strain.

title: Dance Film
overview: This short animated film playfully upends the history of avant garde choreography films by focusing its attention on the spectator of a dance instead of the dancer herself (the filmmaker, Kelly). In some ways it's about watching others watching and what it means to become conscious of our own role as spectators. In other ways it's just a colorful film about a very happy baby watching with delight as her mother dances.

title: Raddi
overview: When time slips through our fingers like sand, the greatest gift our loved ones can give us is the feeling that, even as everything changes, we still matter.

title: COLECTIVO: The First Year
overview: Go behind the scenes of COLECTIVO's inaugural year, as three emerging Latinx filmmakers receive mentorship from Lin-Manuel Miranda and Tribeca Studios, culminating in a Tribeca Festival premiere. Three bold new voices. One extraordinary fellowship.

title: 2 Carrie 2 Momma
overview: Carrie violently faces against a new foe in the form of a scientologist.

title: Hair Fetish Killer
overview: Documents the murder, in which Heather Barnett was found with two clumps of precisely trimmed hair in her hands, and which led detectives to Italy. It took eight years before the discovery of a second victim, Elisa Claps, finally led police to the killer.

title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

title: Ghost
overview: a man awakens in a strange and dreamlike afterlife with no memory of who he was or how he arrived. Guided by a mysterious voice and fragmented glimpses of his past, he begins searching for a way back to the life he abandoned—only to find himself confronting the moment of his death once again.

title: Eye Tag
overview: Two strangers meet through a single glance, and what begins as a fleeting moment quickly becomes something that feels like love at first sight. As their eyes meet, a story begins to unfold... a story filled with romance, connection, and the possibility of a future together. Sometimes, all it takes is one look to imagine what could be.

title: Where Sins Are Buried
overview: After the death of their bank robber father, twin siblings Tom and Anne are forced to pay for his past crimes when they are visited by their long-lost half-brother.

title: Women of Dominica
overview: An intergenerational story of ten women on the Caribbean island of Dominica, interwoven through mentorship, matriarchal wisdom, and ancestral heritage. Bound by the love for their island, the film honors their resilience, identity, and cultural legacy.

title: UNTIL I CAN'T
overview: At his second ever Backyard Ultra Ello ran for 93 Loops breaking the World Record for everyone 27 and under. More important he once again tested the human limit. He made the whole world stop when he laid down in that field making endurance sport history. Together with his Coach Sam Harvey he battled for over 4 days forging a special bond that goes beyond coach and athlete.

title: Because I Love You
overview: After 10 years stranded alone on a spaceship, Nova's life takes an unexpected turn when an alien comes on board. They form a deep bond as they explore the universe together.

title: Jeffrey's Turn
overview: Jeffrey’s Turn based on a true life story of a young Mi’kmag man, Collin Sylliboy on the cusp of adulthood who embarks on a life changing road trip with an almost mythic figure from his past; his uncle Buck. Heeding an urgent call from his uncle, Collin has an adventure that opens his eyes to his Uncle’s tragic past of false incarceration stemming from generations of racism.  As the road unwinds, together they overcome the obstacles that are thrust in their way both externally and internally by ghosts from his uncle’s dark past. With grim determination and humor these two men bond together forever marking young Collin as he finally steps into manhood.  Jeffrey’s Turn with its universal message of coming to terms with your past while learning to live in the present is both hopeful but realistic in its portrayal of living as a Mi’kmag man in today’s society

title: EU VIREI UM MICO e outros imprevistos urbanos
original_title: EU VIREI UM MICO e outros imprevistos urbanos
overview: Suddenly, a man is transformed into a little monkey, to nobody's surprise

title: Khamenei's Last Move
overview: For thirty-six vears, Ali Khamenei prepared Iran for a confrontation he believed would eventually come.  This documentary traces the doctrine he built, the forces that challenged it, and the war that ultimately reached his own home.  He could have moved. He didn't  Did Khamenei simply accept the risk--or did he understand what his death could set in motion?

title: Three Arugula Salads
overview: Young professional Chelsea unravels during the course of a women's-only work lunch as she realizes that it's easier for her coworkers to betray each other than to challenge their toxic corporate culture.

title: Ahyoka
overview: ᎠᏲᎧ is a portrait of Ahyoka Youngdeer, Cherokee culture bearer, teacher, and two-spirit activist. Weaving her own life with a traditional Cherokee story about a crooked-face boy, Ahyoka traces how exclusion was never a Cherokee value and reminds us what it truly means to be a Keetoowah person.

title: Dropping Off
overview: An aspiring musician gigging as a rideshare driver struggles to navigate the bizarre request of a mourning passenger.

title: Cereal Killers
overview: A ex-detective, now turned high school principal attempts to solve a case involving 3 strange students.

title: Jackrabbit
overview: When a coal miner in 1930s Utah hides the loss of his job from his family, the quiet deception sets off a slow-burning collapse.

title: Sport Star
overview: An aging black high school football star, living a quotidian life and married to his high school sweetheart in a small town, reminisces over a long-lost lover - a man he once shared the football field with.

title: The Second Assignment
overview: A film student in the midst of a moral crisis struggles to come up with a concept for his next short film.

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: Sweetest Day
overview: ‘Survivor girl’ Mindy prepares for the battle of her life against the undead confederate soldier that nearly killed her once before.

title: Kill Me Now
overview: A writer on a deadline to finish her first Hollywood thriller seeks solace in her home. Life imitates art as she becomes convinced her neighbor is going to kill her.

title: Perspektywy
overview: Seven girls, seven stories, and one point of view.

title: Bismillah
overview: Haunted by his failure at his Bismillah as a 4 year old, Azhar (Adolyn H. Dar) seeks redemption by re-doing the ceremony - 30 years later as an adult.

title: Wellness Retreat
overview: A successful business woman seeks out a wellness retreat to improve her sleep. When she finds the location is actually a seedy motel, her exhaustion takes the lead and she chooses to stay the night, despite her better judgment.

title: TEENAGERS
overview: Six old friends gather at Megan’s house for a quiet reunion while her parents are away. What begins as a casual night of music, drinks, and nostalgia quickly becomes tense as old memories resurface and the group dynamic begins to fracture. As the night goes on, an unsettling feeling takes hold, turning the familiar setting into something increasingly dangerous.

title: I Have Proof
overview: Plot details are being kept locked in an old VCR, but the film is said to be psychologically charged, and favor 'texture, imperfection, and immediacy over polish'.

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
original_title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
overview: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go awry when a wild beast appears in the woods.

title: Midnight Murungai
overview: A downbeat Toronto-Tamil millennial finds her plan for a free-house is thwarted by her kooky Mom who is acting suspicious.

title: The Long Way to Tipperary
overview: A man returns home.

title: Run Hide Fight: Infidels
overview: When radical Islamist terrorists hijack a liberal college's pro-Palestine encampment, a ragtag band of red-blooded students, a security guard, and a Delta Force vet must arm up to save their clueless peers.

title: The World Is A Wedding
overview: A teenager joins his grandmother at a mahjong game, where he encounters a mysterious woman threatening to unravel secrets from their family's past.

title: The Last Kiss
overview: A young woman discovers she can foresee the death of anyone she kisses, and when a vision predicts her crush will die in a murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to uncover the killer before more lives are lost.

title: Sunlight Water
overview: When a lonely, recently single woman rescues a houseplant in need of serious TLC – and then falls in love with it – she must discover what the plant really wants, or risk losing herself forever.

title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
original_title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
overview: A documentary on Darlene Love, the singer and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee known for “He’s a Rebel” and collaborations with Cher, Bruce Springsteen, Dionne Warwick, Sam Cooke and other greats.

title: Voices
overview: When a rising soul duo overdose just hours before their big break, a desperate bellhop and his closest friends seize the chance of a lifetime, only to discover that the price of fame is blood.

title: The Phone Booth
overview: A man is anxiously waiting for a pay phone to ring, while a dark presence is observing close-by.

title: The Last Photograph
overview: An ex-DEA operative must return to the mountains of South America in an effort to find his missing niece and nephew, following the brutal murders of their diplomat parents. Enlisting the help of a washed-up junkie war photographer, the only person to have seen the face of the killers, he sets out, determined to find the children and the truth, but soon learns he must also face the ghosts of his past.

title: Steamboat Killie
overview: A small town is shaken when a series of brutal murders begins, all linked by one disturbing detail: the killer is dressed in a Mickey Mouse costume. As the body count rises, a group of locals races to uncover who's behind the mask before the killer strikes again.

title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
original_title: The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd
overview: A teacher in an abusive marriage takes a job at a maximum security prison, where she falls for a charismatic inmate. The disastrous consequences call into question not only the nature of punishment and retribution, but the very limits of our humanity.

title: How Much Are You Willing to Sacrifice
original_title: How Much Are You Willing to Sacrifice
overview: Damien Malvolio is a fresh face in the acting scene, he gets handed an audition of a lifetime with a big name director from his hometown (Ransom Wells). His best friend Rigby Hollander is also an actor that gets handed the same role. Rigby Gets the part while Damien falls into madness seeing his best friend steal his role from him. Damien tries everything to take back the role that was destined for him, even if it means ruining their friendship.

title: Purgatory
overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: Dying for Love
overview: In 1991 Miami, a young woman secretly dying of HIV finally finds the man of her dreams, and risks the only thing scarier than her diagnosis—telling the fatal truth to the man she loves.

title: Smudge the Blades
overview: Treaty 6 Blades, an under-18 hockey team from an Alberta reservation, face their last season together while navigating their tough northern league.

title: Eleven Days
overview: In the sweltering heat of a Texas summer in 1974, Jim Estelle, head of the Texas Department of Corrections, plays a deadly game against the ruthless Federico Carrasco, a convicted heroin dealer who has taken over the Huntsville Penitentiary and holding dozens hostage after his pre-planned escape has gone awry. Lines between captor and captive, justice and survival, begin to blur as the siege spirals for eleven endless, terrifying days.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Zoners
overview: A desperate young woman is forced to drive a mercenary and a stolen alien device through a land infested with monsters.

title: Gator Face
overview: A Florida vacation becomes a blood-soaked fight for survival when a group of friends are hunted through the swamps by a savage cult that feeds its victims to ravenous alligators in the name of an ancient reptilian god.

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: Censor Addiction
overview: In 2030, a group of former employees band together to take down a corrupt medical giant determined to increase the levels of crime throughout the country.

title: Place to Be
overview: No-nonsense Brooke and discombobulated divorcee Nelson travel from Chicago to New York to return a lost racing pigeon home.

title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
original_title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
overview: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

title: Deep Dive
overview: After her family is murdered, a champion swimmer infiltrates the killer's home-ready to drown his world in vengeance.

title: The Cactus
overview: As Trysdale prepared for the year-end international exchange formal with Odessey and Malvous in a quiet afternoon, his thoughts drifted to an exchange student named Hecate when he once again locked eyes with the cactus she gave to him, whose fleeting connection with him had dissolved into quiet regret, or maybe there's still a glimpse of chance?

title: Delineations
overview: "Delineations" is an experimental short film highlighting Long Island, New York. Made using satellite images from Google Earth, the film explores nostalgia, growth, and confinement.

title: She Saw Us
overview: When four friends discover a cursed two-headed doll in a remote forest, they unleash a vengeful witch who traps them in a place from which no one has ever escaped.

title: Resident Dead
overview: A man keeping his recently zombified daughter secure in hopes of a cure is tasked with delivering an unknown package through hordes of undead. If he succeeds, he will be given a cure for his daughter. If he fails, or opens the package, they will both be killed.

title: Late Night At The Movies
overview: After an Employee goes missing, Kayleigh is called into work on her only day off. She plans on spending the night after hours only to find that something sinister is lurking throughout the Theater - Stalking her.

title: Once Upon a Time in Suffolk
original_title: Once Upon a Time in Suffolk
overview: An anthology film on the theme of fairy tales - some lighthearted, some more serious in tone, but all with a sprinkle of magic - and all set in the East of England county of Suffolk!

title: Little Singer
overview: Amidst the horizons of Diné land, the legacy of historical trauma echos through generations. At the center, a medicine man and a small school, where grief and resilience meet in song, teaching, and k’é (kinship). Little Singer is rooted in land; carrying the vision and medicine of k’é forward.

title: Eternity One
overview: ETERNITY ONE follows Mary Ella, a young girl growing up on Tangier Island in the Chesapeake Bay, where rising seas have already claimed two-thirds of the land and threaten to erase what remains. Once a thriving fishing community, Tangier now faces the collapse of both home and livelihood.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: AWESOME MAN
overview: Austin Mann's life changes when he comes across a dark orb.

title: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED
overview: When revenge leaves a trail of bodies behind him, fugitive Tommy Crane is hunted by detectives, bounty hunters, and the very criminal empire he tried to destroy—making him go from the hunter to the prey.

title: The Sorrows of Young Charlotte
overview: After a devastating break-up, Charlie sleeps with her friend Werther on a whim. But when he confesses his true feelings for her, an unnerving and darkly explosive argument erupts.

title: The Rattlin' Bog
overview: When three friends embark on a weekend getaway, their bond is put to the test as pride, fragile egos, and jealousy threaten to tear them apart.

title: Bad Karaoke
overview: When wedding band keyboardist Emily discovers an old karaoke machine in the back of a dive bar, she thinks it will lead to a fun-filled night of singing and bonding with her band mates. Unfortunately, this karaoke machine seems to have a thirst for blood. When the singing begins, so does the bloodshed. When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Alien Heart
overview: Miles and Ravi house sit a NASA exobiologist mansion, while running astronomy club sign ups, they discover a runaway alien on a ticking cosmic clock, bullies, and crushes that turn their summer into chaos and adventure.

title: Dietary Restrictions
overview: When Hannah invites Maria over for a date, she cooks up a meal to die for.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: Build Me a Time Machine
overview: Young Woman longs for the innocent feeling of childhood and struggles with the thought of trying to live.

title: Buried in the Snow
overview: The world above ground and the world below.  Below the horizon, there exists a world that belongs neither to the present, future, nor past, surrounded by boulders and waterfalls, where departed life secretly continues its activities. The spirits of those atomic life forms flow in the meandering water, formless yet remembering the past.  Above the horizon, all things that continue to live continue to live. A gust of wind blows, a flurry of snow falls, waiting for winter to pass, waiting for the sun to rise. Memory, like a giant tendril, rises from the ground, its roots seeping into the soil with the melting snow.  Having been here, yet never truly here.  This is a film poem commemorating the passing of a dear friend from my youth. The poem was hand-engraved on a 400-foot-long roll of film.​

title: Ikenga: The Last Festival
overview: In the peaceful kingdom of Umuani, where honor, integrity, and sacred traditions guide the people, the use of dark spiritual forces is strongly condemned. But when a powerful man rises through forbidden powers and tests the resolve of the entire kingdom, the very foundation of their way of life is threatened. As the people suffer under his influence, the king and elders come under immense pressure to restore honor and preserve their sacred traditions.

title: Mind, Body & Soul
overview: A friendly rivalry goes from a casual game of chess to an all-out virtual kumite.

title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
overview: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

title: Protest on the Dancefloor
overview: Protest on the Dancefloor explores how Blackfellas in Melbourne use music and dancefloors to create spaces of sovereignty, connection and liberation amidst an ever-changing political climate.

title: Dya (Country)
overview: A regional First Nations filmmaker explores the Wotjobaluk Nations’ underdog fight for recognition, revealing Treaty as a complex mosaic with deeply local, lived realities unfolding far from Melbourne.

title: Hummingbird
overview: Set in Queens in 2009, this coming-of-age story follows a teen struggling between her overbearing, religious mother and the truth she can no longer deny.

title: Choke
overview: In this colorful satire, a group of ambitious and competitive women tries to climb the corporate ladder as sinister government practices creep closer and closer. Buoyed by comedic talents, this film mocks our current political climate in over-the-top, blood-soaked fashion.

title: Bud Bluntsky's Day Off
overview: After stoner Bud Bluntsky successfully fakes sick to his wife in order to stay home and smoke pot, he goes on an adventure that completely reshapes how he deals with his failing marriage, as he learns the true meaning of Christmas in July.

title: The End of Tom Six
overview: Tom Six, creator of the notorious Human Centipede trilogy, having lived fourteen years with MS in private, sets out to document the end of his life after being unable to release The Onania Club, resulting in this hilarious fever-dream like-documentary feature (with actors) about the absurdity of existence, the film industry, his demise and the restrictions of artistic freedom. ‘The tortured artist is not a myth.’

title: Amaretti
overview: When septuagenarian Lennie's reality is devastated by the discovery of a prolonged, pernicious crime committed against her by her own son, an unexpected connection helps her to begin a journey towards re-forging her fractured identity.

title: American Vampires
overview: A bounty hunter chasing a fugitive across Colorado discovers something much worse hiding beneath a quiet town.

title: Yuletide
overview: Murphy, a young non-binary person returns home for Christmas, bracing for the cold sting of their family’s intolerance. But beneath the Yuletide tree lurks something far more sinister – a mysterious present that swells with every cruel remark, waiting to unleash its dark secret.

title: Plaything
overview: An innocent 20-something Clem is courted by charming Kevin, but as Clem falls deeper, he begins to realize their relationship isn’t just imperfect, but something far more sinister.

title: Black Knights
overview: A short documentary exploring the lives, deep friendship, and resilience of six Black West Point graduates against the backdrop of America's War on Terror. Filmed remotely during the COVID-19 pandemic and the U.S. withdrawal from Afghanistan, the film blends intimate remote interviews, archival military footage, presidential speeches, and personal photos. It chronicles their time at the United States Military Academy, deployments to Iraq, Afghanistan, Kuwait, and South Korea, and transitions into successful civilian careers and graduate school. Notably, the documentary highlights the group's diversity by embracing its LGBTQ+ members. By celebrating profound male bonds, Black Knights challenges traditional narratives and preconceived notions about who serves in the U.S. military and what military service means for America.

title: Sweet 16
overview: The story follows a spoiled, wealthy city girl who is counting down the days to a glamorous, supersonic 16th birthday party where she expects a car as a gift. Her world is turned completely upside down when she is unexpectedly tricked and sent to live in a village for her summer holidays. Forced onto a journey of humility, she must use her sassiness to bring redemption to the village and discover her true self.

title: Sunlight Resonance
overview: A washed-up Hollywood actor wakes up amnesiac, fights through depression, addiction, and guilt.

title: Rocket Friendz
overview: In a world of mediocrity, Theo is a Rocket Friendz Battle Trainer with ONE goal: for he and his Rocket Friend Snout to BE THE BEST! He has been trying for 27 years!

title: Eternal
overview: A killer wandering through the fog begins to question the world around him and his own nature.
